title: My laser got smashed in Transit

posts.topic_title: My laser got smashed in Transit
posts.author: Julian
posts.post_subject: My laser got smashed in Transit
posts.content_md:
Dear all,

 I bid on a 25 mw JDSU laser on Ebay and won. The price was only $150 dollars plus $127 shipping. It was sent by UPS Priority mail. When it reached UK customs they stupidly thought it was a laser pointer even though the tube is 24 inches long and sent it back to Milwaukee, but they did not repack it and it the tube was smashed. So The seller Heuronscience refunded my money, oh well start again. The problem was that in the UK we have banned any laser pointers over 1mw.

posts.post_subject: My laser got smashed in Transit
posts.content_md:
Can't you file a grievance or something and try to get your money back from your government?

I would be furrious and call the gov't every day until they got sick of hearing from me.

posts.topic_title: My laser got smashed in Transit
posts.author: Julian
posts.post_subject: My laser got smashed in Transit
posts.content_md: I got my money back from the vendor, no doubt he will make a claim, as they charged him for the return shipping, and destroyed his goods, but it was the fault of UK Customs and Excise.

Hopefully you will get another laser soon.
